description: This file contains implementation of Python bindings for custom C++ classes in PyTorch JIT, including class initialization, method invocation, and attribute access.

classes.name: ScriptClass
classes.description: A wrapper class for Python interaction with custom C++ classes, enabling instantiation, method calls, and attribute access.

classes.name: ScriptClassFunctionPtr
classes.description: A proxy for static functions of custom classes, allowing them to be called from Python.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Creates an instance of the custom class and calls its __init__ method with provided arguments.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Retrieves static methods of the custom class by name, enabling attribute-style access.

methods.name: __doc__
methods.description: Returns the documentation string of the custom class.

methods.name: _get_custom_class_python_wrapper
methods.description: Returns a ScriptClass wrapping the constructor of a specified custom class by namespace and name.
